valuation_basis: Agreed property price RMB842.0m equalled the appraised value; a fair value uplift to RMB842.0m (S$156.9m) was recognised as at 31 Dec 2023 when classified held-for-sale.
gain_on_divestment_basis: Gain on disposal of subsidiary S$7,309k (Consolidated statement of total return p91; subsidiary-disposal Note B p100). Sale consideration S$140,720k, net identifiable assets divested S$130,471k, realisation of translation reserves S$2,940k.
carrying_value_basis: Investment properties carrying value in subsidiary-disposal cash-flow Note B (p100), S$156,570k.
note: Divestment of the subsidiary (CapitaRetail Beijing Shuangjing Real Estate Co., Ltd.) holding CapitaMall Shuangjing, a Beijing retail mall. Announced 6 Dec 2023, completed 23 Jan 2024 at agreed property price RMB842.0m; exit yield 2.8%. Structured as disposal of subsidiary, so the S$7,309k gain is EXCLUDED from net_property_sales per convention (kept in line_items as an adjustment). Net cash inflow S$127,438k (cash-flow Note B, p100). Partial-year FY2024 P&L to completion: GR S$87k, NPI S$(4)k.
